title: Tethered canary + A/B validation for pinned model revisions with automated traffic fallbacks
creator: Sofia Patel
description:
Goal: Provide a safe, observable mechanism to validate new model revisions that are pinned by customers. The feature must allow engineers and PMs to run tethered canaries and lightweight A/B tests behind user/route pins with automatic progressive traffic shifts and emergency fallbacks. This ticket covers requirements, acceptance criteria, rollout automation, monitoring dashboards, and the handoff artifacts for SRE/runtime to implement runtime gating and traffic shaping.

Motivation: Customers pin a model revision to ensure reproducibility. Today there is no first-class way to test a later revision for compatibility/perf/QA while keeping the pin. Teams need a way to exercise candidate revisions in production traffic slices without removing the pin or creating long-lived alternate deployments.

Scope:
- Define the UX/controls for enabling tethered canaries and A/B experiments on pinned routes (API + Console).
- Define traffic scheduling primitives (fixed split, ramp, randomized sample) and a safety circuit for automatic rollback to pinned revision.
- Specify required performance profile publications and compatibility checks before canary activation.
- Define observability and alerting (metrics, regression thresholds, eval prompt sets) and pre-built dashboards.
- Provide test plan and post-launch rollout checklist for runtime and console teams.

Out of scope: Full experiment-analysis UI (will link to Redwood Optimize follow-up), multi-region cross-rollouts (handled in separate infra ticket).
acceptance_criteria: API + Console controls exist to attach a candidate revision to an existing pin as a "tethered canary" and configure traffic split/ramp windows.
Activation requires published performance profile for candidate revision and a successful compatibility check (tokenization/schema parity) before traffic is allowed.
Runtime can route a configurable percentage of requests for a pinned route to the candidate revision and automatically revert traffic to the pinned revision if any safety gate is tripped.

Out-of-the-box dashboards for the experiment show: latency P50/P95/P99, token cost per request, error rate (5xx/timeout), semantic-similarity degradation per validation prompts, and top utterance mismatches.
A documented rollback policy and a single-click emergency stop are available in Console and via API.
E2E tests and a small canary in staging cover schema compatibility, traffic split correctness, and rollback triggers.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: API and Console MVP behind a feature flag (internal customers only) for 2 teams. Phase 2: Add automated compatibility gating and public beta. Phase 3: GA with 24/7 monitoring and runbook. Feature-flag roadmap lives in the runtime-qa epic and will be toggled per team. Expected rollout: internal -> beta -> GA over 6 weeks once runtime integration validated.
monitoring: health_gates: if p95 increases >20% OR semantic similarity drops >3% OR 5xx_rate doubles -> trigger automated rollback

2026-03-04 - Marco Liu: Noted need for performance profile publication to be a gating artifact. If no profile exists, disallow canary activation. Added dependency on ENG-4300 (perf-profile publisher).
2026-03-07 - Priya Nambiar (Eng): Prototype routing shim implemented in staging. Found edge case when model names differ in tokenizer; added compatibility check task.

2026-03-09 - Design review (Aisha Raman): Console flow should expose quick glance risk indicators (latency delta, cost delta, quality delta) and require explicit acknowledgement for >10% cost increase.
2026-03-10 - Security (Jonas Becker): Confirmed audit log requirement; must record who started/stopped experiment and exact traffic splits. Marked security_review_required.
2026-03-11 - QA (Leah Kim): Test harness plan drafted. We'll use 3 synthetic prompt sets: latency-heavy, cost-heavy, and quality-sensitive. Plan to run 5000 sample queries for internal pilot.

2026-03-12 - Marco Liu: Added emergency rollback criteria: p95>baseline*1.2, semantic_similarity_drop>3%, 5xx_rate>baseline*2. Rolling update window default 30 minutes with exponential ramp (1%,5%,10%,25%,50%).

2026-03-14 - Sofia Patel: Drafted user docs and internal playbook. Creating GA checklist once runtime implements automated fallback. Next: pair with Eng to finalize API contract and seq-labeling for routes.
